### Highlights

- **Faster update checks** — Git repositories, release-based projects, and curated MPQ patches now check concurrently through bounded workloads that retain Wuddle's cancellation and timeout safeguards.
- **More reliable repository updates** — Stale and duplicate cached update entries are discarded, and Update All skips repositories removed after the batch was prepared instead of aborting the remaining updates.
  - This is intended to address [Issue #18](https://github.com/ZythDr/Wuddle/issues/18), which remains open pending confirmation from the reporter.
- **Reliable Lutris launching** — Selecting Lutris now uses only the saved Lutris target. Hidden Custom command values can no longer replace the Lutris executable or append unrelated arguments.

For the complete technical details, see the [full v3.7.0-beta.8 changelog](https://github.com/ZythDr/Wuddle/blob/v3.7.0-beta.8/CHANGELOG.md#v370-beta8).
